vision: An extensible developer productivity suite for [Google Antigravity](https://antigravity.google/docs/plugins/). Built natively in TypeScript/Node.js, i — Provides an autonomous, developer-friendly experience with first-class TypeScript integration and modular architecture.

targetAudience.primary: Developers & AI Engineers looking for automated agent extensions

phases.name: Phase 1: Foundation & Core Experience
phases.description: Core MVP architecture, primary user workflows, and essential reliability foundations.

phases.name: Phase 2: Competitor Differentiation & Workflow Power
phases.description: Features addressing major competitor user pain points and establishing clear market superiority.

phases.name: Phase 3: Scale, Ecosystem & Autonomous Intelligence
phases.description: Advanced ecosystem integrations, telemetry, automation, and team collaboration.

features.title: Core Engine & Modular Architecture
features.description: Establish modular extensible plugin system for antigravity-tools with strict separation of concerns.
features.rationale: Solid base prevents architectural debt and enables seamless module addition without regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: All modules implement unified PluginModule lifecycle interface
Automated registry dynamically loads tools and REST routes
Unit test coverage exceeds 80% for core contracts
userStories: As a Developers & AI Engineers looking for automated agent extensions, I want a modular architecture so that new tools can be added reliably.

features.title: Interactive Sidecar & Web Pane UI
features.description: Provide an intuitive Sidecar Aux Pane and Web Dashboard for visual interactions and fast execution.
features.rationale: Solves the disjointed developer experience common in CLI-only and config-heavy tools.
acceptanceCriteria: Sidecar loads seamlessly inside IDE aux pane with security token handshake
Clean tabbed interface switching between Prompt Library and AI Roadmap
Responsive design with dark mode support matching IDE theme
userStories: As a Developers & AI Engineers looking for automated agent extensions, I want a visual sidecar UI so that I don't have to remember manual commands.

features.title: 1-Click Prompt Library & Clipboard Injection
features.description: Curated and customizable prompt templates with instant clipboard copy and parameter substitution.
features.rationale: Eliminates repetitive manual typing and elevates prompt engineering consistency across tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Filter prompts by category, tags, and search query
Dynamic parameter substitution before copying
System clipboard injection completes in < 50ms
userStories: As a developer, I want to quickly paste battle-tested prompts so that I get higher quality AI responses instantly.

features.title: Automated Codebase Introspection & Discovery
features.description: Deep AST & file scanning that automatically extracts tech stack, personas, vision, and gaps.
features.rationale: Removes manual setup friction by letting the AI immediately understand any repo context.
acceptanceCriteria: Detects package.json, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml, go.mod
Extracts README summaries and TODO/FIXME comments
Outputs structured JSON compliant with Aperant-style discovery schema
userStories: As a tech lead, I want the tool to analyze our repository so that roadmap features are grounded in our actual stack.

features.title: Competitor Pain Point Benchmarking & MoSCoW Prioritization
features.description: Direct & indirect competitor intelligence mapping user complaints to strategic feature priorities.
features.rationale: Ensures roadmap builds what wins market share rather than random guesses.
acceptanceCriteria: Maps real user complaints (Reddit, GitHub, Reviews) with severity and frequency
Links feature IDs directly to competitor pain point IDs
Prioritizes features addressing high-severity competitor flaws with MoSCoW tags
userStories: As a product planner, I want feature suggestions tied to competitor shortcomings so that our product has a clear competitive edge.

features.title: ROADMAP.md One-Click Git Export
features.description: Export rich, formatted markdown roadmap with phase progress checkboxes directly into the project root.
features.rationale: Keeps roadmap committed alongside code for transparent team-wide tracking.
acceptanceCriteria: Writes ROADMAP.md to project root or downloads via web dashboard
Preserves user story details, acceptance criteria, and competitor links
Interactive checkbox markers matching completion state
userStories: As a repository owner, I want a committed ROADMAP.md file so that our whole team and contributors stay aligned.

features.title: MCP Protocol Tool Bridge for Autonomous Execution
features.description: Expose all roadmap and prompt operations as Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools for AI agents.
features.rationale: Allows AI pair programmers (Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor) to autonomously plan and execute.
acceptanceCriteria: Full MCP tool registry adhering to JSON-RPC specification
Agent can query roadmap, update feature progress, and request competitor gaps
Graceful error handling and input validation
userStories: As an autonomous coding agent, I want MCP tools to inspect and update roadmap status during coding tasks.

features.title: Multi-Project Analytics & Cloud Sync
features.description: Cross-repository workspace management, trend analytics, and team roadmap sharing.
features.rationale: Extends utility across multi-repo organizations and team workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: Aggregate progress across multiple workspaces
Export roadmap to JSON/CSV for external PM tools (Linear/Jira)
Optional cloud synchronization with team permission control
userStories: As an engineering director, I want to see roadmap progress across multiple repositories in a single view.
